args.title: Admin review title padded far in excess of the Magento review title cap so feasibility flags the payload as length_exceeded rather than request_failed
args.detail: This admin-channel review body is intentionally padded past the Magento column limit so Phase 2c classifies the rejection as length_exceeded.
